source: Official PS5 trophy list as published via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18); every guide below is written for this entry and derives its steps from the official description.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first and this one pops on its own the moment the last one lands. Follow the roadmap in order — story, then side strands, then collectibles, then cleanup — so no trophy is left behind for a second playthrough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Run the opening mission Gone Fishing from start to finish and follow the on-screen prompts. As the very first story mission it is the trophy nearly everyone earns first, and it needs no setup at all.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops when the chapter's closing mission ends, so just keep playing the golden story markers in order.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Play the story markers as they appear and the trophy unlocks at the chapter finale.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Keep following the story path; the trophy pops at the end of the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so it pops naturally near the end of the story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Play through the final story mission to its end. Before you start it, clear the missable side-strand finales from stage 2 of the roadmap — a few strands shut for good once the story wraps up.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears on the map. Story missions can be replayed from the pause menu if anything goes wrong, so there is no way to miss it.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist through to the getaway. Load up on armour and ammo before the heist kicks off, then stick to the mission objectives until you are clear.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks in the story flow, so keep playing the main missions and it will appear.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Bring a fast car for the mission's driving sections and follow the waypoint prompts.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. Expect heavy resistance at the airport, so arrive with full health and a stocked weapon wheel.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a late-story set piece, so it pops as you work through the final chapters.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Hit 100% completion on the in-game stats screen — story, side strands, collectibles and activities all finished. Treat it as the last gold before the platinum and use the checklist to spot whatever is still open.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long air time and two-wheel driving all count. Chain them during free roam driving instead of grinding one spot; the counter ticks up across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once: racing, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and stunt jumps. Visit one of each early so the trophy pops while you explore.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Walk each range once at a slow pace to learn where the targets appear, then chase the gold time; a steady aim beats rushing, and every challenge can be retried as often as you like.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's corners on a practice lap, then race clean — hitting gates in order matters more than top speed.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida. Vary the race types and locations instead of repeating one event; each new race you win adds to the count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing duel and out-fish him. Watch the line tension and reel in steadily — jerking the rod loses the catch, and Cal will not wait for a rematch the same day.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Walk into any arcade, pick one game and play it to completion. The easiest pick is the shortest game on the machine, so try the quickest cabinet first.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand all the way to its final mission. Side strands can shut as the story moves forward, so take Andy's missions the moment they show up instead of leaving them for after the finale.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Do Kenton's strand before the final story mission, because strand finales are the easiest trophies to lock yourself out of.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Clear Billy's missions when they unlock instead of saving them for the endgame.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as question marks on the map; finish each strand you find and the count grows — eight finished strands pops the silver.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Play Randy's missions promptly when they unlock; strands left unfinished can become unavailable after the story moves on.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Like the other strand finales, do Tyrone's missions before the final story mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Spots sit at scenic viewpoints, so sweep the map region by region and meditate at each one you pass.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track and hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. It appears only in one area and can flee if spooked, so approach slowly, save first, and take the shot only when you are close.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Finish 3 full collectible card sets. Cards turn up in shops, interiors and street corners across Leonida; work through one set at a time and swap duplicates wherever the game lets you.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. It counts per location, so spread it out — tag a new spot every time you enter a new district instead of farming one place.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more, so they pile up naturally; check the challenge list in the pause menu to see which are closest to done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get to a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then shake the cops off together. Break line of sight, duck into an alley or swap cars, and wait the stars out — both of you have to escape for it to count.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level alive the whole time. Plan a route of three close shops, keep moving, and do not let the heat drop between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by getting in or driving them. Every new model you sit in counts, so hop into anything unfamiliar you see parked or driving by.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one Combat Focus. Trigger it in a crowded firefight with enemies grouped together, and chain the slow-motion shots without letting the meter run out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA airport in an unscheduled way — grab a plane and take off without following the normal departure. It is a one-shot stunt, so save before you try and retry from the save if it fails.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank — they show up during high-wanted-level chaos or military encounters — then put its cannon and armour to work in a fight. Pick open ground with room to turn; a Rhino wedged in tight streets is a sitting duck.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, grab the goods and leave before the alarm — if you are spotted, reload your save and try a stealthier route.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and get away clean each time. Sort the escape before you walk in — a quick car waiting nearby turns a vault job from a shootout into a clean getaway.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush one on a quiet road, crack it open, take the cash and lose the wanted level before the trophy pops.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive the map edge to edge and the area counter fills in; the last few areas are usually the rural corners, so sweep those deliberately.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Each gang's operation sits in its own territory, so work through the map gang by gang until all nine are hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail at a bar on Ocean Beach and enjoy the view. Any beachfront bar works — sit, order, and let the scene play out.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive straight through the glass in a fast car. Pick a showroom with a clear exit line and go for it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Follow through on every frame — a complete game is what counts, not the score.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Build your partnership's appeal with your partner through shared activities — dates, drives and missions together. Keep showing up for your partner and the partnership moment triggers on its own once your bond is strong enough.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Decide whenever the game asks you to. The count runs up to 500 choices, so answer every prompt rather than skipping past it — a few choices show up only once, so think each one through before you pick.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try after failing once. If something goes wrong, do not reload an old save right away — retry the attempt itself, because the second attempt is what this trophy watches for.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Witness a strange random event out in Leonida. Roam the rural roads and odd corners of the map — the event finds you, so keep exploring off the beaten path.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: drive past on a bike or in a car and swing a melee weapon as you pass. A slow pass on a quiet street makes the timing easy.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies, so bank them through contacts little by little until the total hits $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars and food all count toward the total, so normal shopping across the playthrough gets you most of the way there.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Save up and purchase them as they appear on the property market; each garage also gives you storage, so they pay for themselves.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Sign up 10 vehicles on the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the app and register each one — rare models are not required, any ten will do.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (2026-11-18).
